text: I think I have just the thing for you! This Sesame Pea Pods recipe is a great fit for you because it's gluten-free, which aligns with your dietary needs. The ingredients are also relatively light, which should fit within your 60-minute time budget. Plus, the dish is quite simple to prepare, so you can whip it up quickly. As a bonus, the recipe includes healthy fats from the sesame oil and seeds, which might be a nice complement to your love of chocolate. Give it a try!
